items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: He used to teach, know, teach music, all instruments. And I learned mostly my notes from Charlotte.

ctx.x: He was busy half of the time.

And when he wasn't busy he was resting at home. I left my wife and tell me, you know, one of those things, you know, resting or so. So I left him and I went to a fellow we called Charlotte and he was a letter carrier, he was an old man. St. Claude, I think he was in the main. He used to teach, you know, teach music, all instruments. And I learned mostly my notes from Charlotte. And I began to sprout around from one little outfit to the other. One when they need to sit in, you know, man to sit in, man is a trumpet…
Well who did you, you developed your style along? Anybody influenced you?
